analysis: Both units are head-side excerpts of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (lines 1981-2868). This is a documentation-only change; no executable code, config, or security control is modified. The visible excerpts cover restart, status, doctor, models, benchmark, update, beta, fan, login/logout, enroll/unenroll, logs and report. The patch excerpt shows the `sandbox` row now requiring a Darkbloom Sandbox waitlist approval for `setup` (line ~182), which is a gating statement in docs; the TB-013 and T-061 installer-download implications cannot be verified from this evidence, since no code changed. The doc text describes existing behaviour consistent with the threat model: logout/remote revocation (A-008, T-053), App Attest authorization (A-016, T-053/T-057), report upload scoped to the operator, privilege-limited sudo for the profile inventory, and prefix-cache posture (T-041). None of the documented statements weakens or contradicts an assumption in the supplied threat model. The excerpt in `patch_excerpt` is truncated, and the changed ranges (head 1360-1385, 1635-1727) fall outside the supplied head text units, so the new text in those ranges (including the waitlist section and any gpu-limit/cluster docs) was not examined. Remaining question for integration: whether the new waitlist section (head ~1635-1727) describes any new network call or credential/identity data sent to a service, which would be new attack surface affecting TB-013 or A-019 and should be checked against the corresponding code changes.
